The event begins around f5 (53.0 s) when the SUV’s brakes engage sharply and contact occurs, and continues through f21 (62.0 s) with sustained contact/immobilization.

events.description: A white SUV abruptly enters the lane from the right and cuts sharply in front of the dashcam vehicle, causing visible tire skid marks and a sudden deceleration; the SUV’s rear wheels appear to lose traction or strike debris, consistent with a minor collision or loss-of-control event.

verification.reason: In f4 (100.5 s), the white SUV appears suddenly on the right edge; by f5 (101.0 s), it is fully in the lane with visible spray/debris and skewed orientation, and the road surface shows fresh skid marks—indicating an impact or near-impact event within that interval. No other vehicles are involved visibly, but the abrupt maneuver and physical evidence meet the definition of CarAccident (crash or loss-of-control incident involving a vehicle).
